care_continuity: National isolation/CTE stock: 916, equal to the five provincial stocks; no national confirmed/suspect split.
Ituri: 384 patients at a printed 37.0%, 44 critical; 60 admissions, 82 exits, 11 recoveries.

Nord-Kivu (page 7): 464 hospitalized (161 confirmed, 303 suspects), 333 in CTE/CT for 392 beds (printed 84.9%) and 131 in non-dedicated facilities; 333+131=464 reconciles. The 84.9% is a CTE/CT-only rate and the census exceeds the bed count, so no all-census occupancy is inferred. The care challenge prints the 131 as 28.2%, which matches 131/464.
Haut-Uele: 44 patients for 169 beds (26.0%), 4 severe or critical; 5 suspect admissions and 8 exits (6 non-cases, 2 confirmed deaths).
Tshopo: 21 patients for 36 beds (58.3%), none severe; 7 confirmed admitted from the Bafwasende CT and 3 confirmed cases remain lost to follow-up.
Bas-Uele: 3 patients in isolation; no new confirmed case.
challenges: Contacts 27976/35306 (79.2%), up from 78.0% but below the 95% threshold; 7330 unseen (20.8%). The prose says five provinces transmitted but prints rates for four: Nord-Kivu 83.1% (14204/17084), Haut-Uele 87.9% (1515/1723), Bas-Uele 91.8% (626/682) and Sud-Ubangi 100% (44/44). Ituri and Tshopo print no rate; only Sud-Ubangi reaches 95%.

Alerts: Tableau 3 validates or invalidates all 3779 alerts while the prose prints 3421 verified (92.9%). 545 validated as suspects (printed 15.9%), 529 investigated (97.1%; prose 528) and 240 transferred (printed 44.1%). The 16 suspects not investigated are all in Ituri; none of the Bas-Uele, Sud-Ubangi or Tshopo suspects transferred.

PoE/PoC completeness 111/119 (93.3%): Sud-Kivu 55.6% (5/9) with the Baraka-Fizi antennas not reporting and no isolation at Kavimvira, Kalundu Port SNCC and Baraka; Nord-Kivu 90.5% (19/21) with Butuhe PoC closed since 26 September, threats on the Butembo axis and PoC alerts not handled on time; Haut-Uele's Mutowamba PoC did not report for lack of network; Ituri's Avakubi PoC is non-functional for insecurity and September provider pay is late; Bas-Uele 19/41 PoE/PoC functional (46.3%).

Ituri rings 16/26 (61.5%), 24 EDS failed, 14 postponed and 21 of 90 bodies (23.3%) not swabbed; Nord-Kivu ring gaps at Katwa, Butembo and Masereka, households 10/23 decontaminated, 45 EDS postponed and 36 of 57 alerted deaths (63.2%) in non-dedicated facilities; Tshopo IPC supplies short, the Makiso-Kisangani HGR incinerator broken and only 5 of 104 facilities (4.8%) above an 80% IPC score; Haut-Uele 4/7 zones sent IPC data; Bas-Uele 16/20 priority facilities without functional triage and 17/20 without 72-hour water storage.

Ituri: 384 patients at a printed 37.0% occupancy with no bed denominator, 44 critical; limited capacity at Nyankunde, Kilo, Mangala and Biakato, blood stock down to 16 units, no food for 8 patients in Mandima, ambulance movement reporting 18/33.
Nord-Kivu: CTE/CT occupancy 333/392 (84.9%), suspect beds 175/183 (95.6%) and 131 patients (28.2%) hospitalized outside CTE/CT.

Nord-Kivu ambulance response capacity limited to 50% (14/28) with incomplete ambulance data at Butembo and Mutwanga; Bas-Uele has no ambulance for transfers and its standard CTE at HGR Buta is still under construction.

Haut-Uele: 44 patients for 169 beds (26.0%), no working Starlink link at every CTE; Tshopo: 21 patients for 36 beds (58.3%; 92.9% of confirmed beds), lacking resuscitation equipment, specialists and PEP staff, with 3 confirmed cases lost to follow-up.

Ituri's target for frontline workers remains to be redefined (1120 vaccinated against a provisional 1000); Bas-Uele cold-chain units are not running, vaccine quantities are insufficient and vaccination funds are awaited. Vaccine logistics do not establish efficacy against Bundibugyo.

A baseline assessment of the CH Carl Becker (Nord-Kivu) found a one-bed triage, no PPE, no backup generator, 40% of maternity staff untrained in SONUB/CPNr and no neonatology; 16 confirmed cases were recorded there, 1 of them a provider, and 5 providers are quarantined. Tshopo HIV test kits are out of stock at the CS militaire Ketele.

Ituri psychosocial coverage reaches 14/28 affected zones (50.0%) and Mandima, with 51.2% of the province's confirmations of the day, is not covered; Bas-Uele SMSPS coverage is embryonic; Haut-Uele data from Pawa and Wamba did not arrive; none of the 7 new Bafwasende confirmations (Tshopo) is yet covered.

Tshopo: community resistance and physical aggression or threats against rapid-response teams at Bafwasende, where a patient's body was taken by force from the Red Cross EDS team on 14 October; Nord-Kivu threats on the Butembo PoC axis persist.
highlights: DRC: 9,348 confirmed cases and 4,510 confirmed deaths as of 15 October 2026 (CFR 48.2%).

priorities: Strengthen epidemiological surveillance and contact follow-up to limit community transmission: contact follow-up rose from 78.0% but remains below the 95% threshold, and 16 suspects remain uninvestigated in Ituri.
Keep surveillance vigilance, consolidate IPC and community engagement, and deliver quality care in dedicated facilities with adequate capacity.

Deaths and recoveries move cleanly: 4478 to 4510 (+32) and 2486 to 2507 (+21). The 24-hour death movement is 32: 18 community plus 14 intra-CTE (cover: 6 CTE deaths in Ituri, 6 in Nord-Kivu, 2 in Haut-Uele).

Alerts (pages 4-5): Tableau 3 validates or invalidates every one of its 3779 alerts (3779 verified), while the prose prints 3421 verified at 92.9% (3421/3779 is 90.5%). Printed 15.9% validated is 545/3421. Tableau 3 and the key messages give 529 of 545 suspects investigated (97.1%); the prose prints 528 at 97.1%. The prose names five reporting provinces and omits Sud-Ubangi, which Tableau 3 carries with 98 alerts. Transfers 240 print as 44.1%; 240/545 is 44.0%. Not repaired.

Contacts: 79.2% is 27976/35306 (cover and prose); the key messages print 79.3%. The prose says five provinces transmitted and prints four provincial rates; 11587 seen of 15773 under follow-up are not attributed to any printed province, and no Ituri or Tshopo rate is derived.

Nord-Kivu (page 7): 464 hospitalized (161 confirmed, 303 suspects), 333 in CTE/CT for 392 beds (printed 84.9%) and 131 in non-dedicated facilities; 333+131=464 reconciles. The 84.9% is a CTE/CT-only rate and the census exceeds the bed count, so no all-census occupancy is inferred. The care challenge prints the 131 as 28.2%, which matches 131/464.

Ituri (page 7) prints 384 patients at 37.0% occupancy (47.0% suspects, 27.0% confirmed) with no bed denominator and no confirmed/suspect split; none is carried or back-calculated. 60 admissions and 82 exits from SR153's 407 give 385, not 384.

Haut-Uele care panel (page 7): 5 admissions, all suspects (Wamba 3, Pawa 2), while Tableau 2 gives Pawa 1 new confirmation. 43+5-8=40 against the printed 44. Its 2 confirmed deaths match Tableau 2 (Pawa and Wamba intra-CTE). Not repaired.

Isolation: the cover 916 equals the five provincial stocks 384+464+44+21+3; Ituri and Bas-Uele print no confirmed/suspect split, so no national split is derived. Nord-Kivu (453+97-86=464) and Tshopo (13+8+1 readmission-1=21) follow from SR153 plus same-day flows; Ituri (385 vs 384), Haut-Uele (40 vs 44) and Bas-Uele (8 to 3 with no printed movement) do not. Not repaired.

PoE/PoC (pages 5-6): Tableau 4 covers Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Tshopo and Haut-Uele and the prose agrees: 14 alerts, 7 validated live suspects (3 transferred), 4 bodies (2 swabbed or secured). Three Ituri alerts are neither live suspects nor bodies. No case is inferred.

Laboratory (page 6): 462 samples, 71 positive (15.4%), split 53 living and 18 deceased; deceased positives match Tableau 2's community deaths in every province. Nord-Kivu prints 17.8% for 22 of 128 samples (17.2%); the count ratio is carried and the printed value preserved.

Key messages (page 10) now agree with Tableau 3 on 529/545 investigated and 16 uninvestigated in Ituri, and say contact follow-up remains below 95%; they print 79.3% against the cover's 79.2%. Not repaired.
SMSPS challenge (page 9): Mandima concentrates 51.2% of Ituri's confirmations of the day, which matches Tableau 2 (21 of 41).

Vaccination (page 8): Ituri reports 87 more vaccinated for a cumulative 1120 (SR153 1033 + 87); the challenge prints the same 1120 against a provisional target of 1000. Haut-Uele 503 of 1060 pre-registered (47.5%: 470 Isiro, 33 Pawa).
